titles.title: The Black Place III

description: Two large sets of rolling hills dip down into a valley, creating a series of U-shapes throughout the center of the composition. The leftmost hills are darker, almost black, and a line through the valley's center shows where the two hill formations meet. Hints of red and yellow add depth to the landscape.
